name: Ramzan Amin
headline: ERP transformation & assurance | Founder at SIM Consulting
about:
I work in and around complex ERP and digital transformation programmes, primarily in public sector and regulated environments where delivery risk, governance and stakeholder confidence really matter. Over the past several years, my focus has been on the reality of ERP change - not just strategy, but what actually happens when legacy processes, data complexity, audit requirements and quarterly releases collide.

My background spans infrastructure, cloud platforms, DevOps, SaaS and large-scale data migration, which means I tend to operate at the intersection of technology, programme delivery and business accountability. Much of my work sits alongside CIOs, finance leaders and programme teams who need clearer assurance, fewer surprises and better visibility across change.

More recently, I’ve been involved in multi-year public sector ERP programmes, supporting assurance, testing and governance models that reduce friction, build confidence and help teams move faster without cutting corners. Alongside consulting and delivery work, I’m closely involved in the development of Testify, SIM Consulting’s testing automation platform. It was shaped directly by what we repeatedly saw slowing programmes down: manual testing bottlenecks, fragile scripts and limited accessibility beyond specialist teams.

Bridging the gap between IT delivery and business accountabilityI use LinkedIn mainly to share observations from the field and to learn how others are approaching similar challenges. If our worlds overlap, it’s always useful to connect.
